'''Attack Pattern Tartarus''' was a [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] tactic used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Used under the auspices of [[Formation Besh]], it entails dropping out of hyperspace right on top of an enemy upon verifying their position via a nearby starfighter squadron both to surprise them and to block their hyperspace vector.

==History==
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox|Lennox]] used this tactic to attack [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]] with his group of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]].
